evals.name: visual-bug-fix
evals.prompt: Open a before/after in my browser so I can reproduce the old scroll bug and the fixed behavior side by side, then take a screenshot.
evals.expected_output: A browser-openable artifact drives the same action against clearly labelled baseline and changed states, exposes direct evidence, and is composed for a useful screenshot.
assertions: Creates a dated HTML artifact outside the compared code repository
Uses the same input and visual basis for before and after
Provides one obvious replay, trigger, or reset action
Labels real builds, fixtures, and simulations honestly
Returns an absolute path and exact open command

evals.name: benchmark-delta
evals.prompt: Make me a clean before/after page for these benchmark results: renders 26 to 1, cursor replies 2/2 to 2/2, final mismatches 0 to 0. I want the key change obvious and the exact table underneath.
evals.expected_output: The render delta dominates the first read, while a semantic table preserves exact metrics and unchanged correctness guards without decorative KPI clutter.
assertions: Leads with the decisive 26 to 1 relationship
Includes a semantic table with aligned numeric columns
Preserves units and unchanged guard metrics
Does not represent favorable values with decorative green styling
Does not invent a latency or causation claim

evals.name: feature-tour
evals.prompt: I want to appreciate the whole new keyboard protocol feature, not just read the diff. Give me a before/after with a small simulator and proof that both real cores behave the same.
evals.expected_output: A feature tour opens with the old limitation versus new capability, adds a minimal contract-faithful simulator, and closes with real-boundary evidence and limitations.
assertions: Places the before/after comparison before implementation detail
Uses interaction to expose the feature contract rather than decorate the page
Separates simulated examples from real-core proof
Includes limitations of the browser or substrate
Uses Geist typography and restrained Vercel visual rules
